defs.def: show or make a connection between two or more things 联系；使有联系；把 … 联系起来

ex.s: The differences between print and digital reading results are partly related to paper’s physical properties.
ex.t: 印刷和数字阅读结果之间的差异部分与纸张的物理特性有关。

ex.s: What do the underlined words “relate to” in paragraph 2 mean?
ex.t: 第二段中带下划线的词“relate to”是什么意思？

ex.s: Dr Prinstein has also found that the qualities that made the neighbors want you on a play date-sharing, kindness, openness — carry over to later years and make you better able to relate and connect with others.
ex.t: 普林斯坦博士还发现，那些让邻居愿意和你一起玩的品质——分享、善良、开放——会延续到以后 years，使你更好地与他人建立联系和沟通。

ex.s: Relating to other people.
ex.t: 与他人建立联系。

ex.s: Which family do you relate to most?
ex.t: 你和哪个家庭最有共鸣？

ex.s: Words are not enough to relate such wonders!
ex.t: 言语不足以描述这样的奇观！

defs.def: to give a spoken or written report of sth; to tell a story 叙述；讲述；讲（故事）
to be connected with sth/sb; to refer to sth/sb 涉及；与 … 相关；谈到

ex.s: But when he went bike shopping, he found few available, which got him thinking: What if the 20  of bikes was Covid-19 related, and what if the person who'd taken his bike really needed 21    to get to work?
ex.t: 但当他去买自行车时发现几乎没有可买的车这让他思考：如果自行车的   20   缺乏与新冠疫情有关呢如果拿走他车的人真的需要   21    去上班呢？

ex.s: This is quite important, because it is directly related to your commitment.
ex.t: 这一点非常重要，因为它与你的投入程度直接相关。

ex.s: The real problem relates to the possibility that artificial intelligence(AI) may become extremely good at achieving something other than what we really want.
ex.t: 真正的问题与这样一种可能性有关：人工智能（AI）可能变得极其擅长实现某些并非我们真正想要的东西。

ex.s: Over 28 states have passed laws related to pollinator habitat protection and pesticide use.
ex.t: 超过28个州已通过与传粉昆虫栖息地保护和杀虫剂使用相关的法律。

ex.s: The part of the brain related to pleasure is activated in response to something we find beautiful.
ex.t: 与愉悦相关的大脑部分会对我们发现的美的事物作出反应而被激活。

ex.s: come up with new ideas about how testing relates to teaching
ex.t: 想出关于测试如何与教学相关的新点子

ex.s: A “habit loop(环)” is a way of describing several related elements that produce habits.
ex.t: "习惯循环"是描述产生习惯的几个相关要素的一种方式。

ex.s: After taking a degree at Chichester University in Related Arts, Ginni began to travel the world, eventually getting work teaching English in Japan and Chile.
ex.t: 在Chichester大学获得相关艺术学位后，Ginni开始周游世界，最终在日本和智利找到了教英语的工作。

ex.s: High conscientiousness is related to lower job performance, especially in simple jobs where it doesn’t pay to be a perfectionist.
ex.t: 高度的责任心与较低的工作绩效有关，特别是在简单的工作中，作为一个完美主义者是不需要付出代价的。

ex.s: Let your expertise in one field fuel your passions in all related areas.
ex.t: 让你在某一领域的专长激发你在所有相关领域的热情。

ex.s: Timekeeping is increasingly related to nature．
ex.t: 计时越来越与自然相关．

ex.s: It's almost impossible to learn about one historical period without having dozens of questions about related concepts.
ex.t: 不了解一个历史时期，几乎不可能不对相关概念产生几十个问题。

ex.s: Through the Summer Employment Opportunities program, students are hired each year in a variety of summer positions across the Provincial Public Service, its related agencies and community groups.
ex.t: 通过“暑期就业机会”项目，学生每年会被雇用到省内公共服务部门、相关机构和社区团体的各种暑期岗位。

ex.s: In analyzing his and other research，Dr Prinstein came to another conclusion: Not only is likability related to positive life outcomes, but it is also responsible for those outcomes, too.
ex.t: 在分析他自己和其他人的研究时，普林斯坦博士得出了另一个结论：不仅讨人喜欢与积极的生活结果相关，而且也是这些结果的原因。

ex.s: When your boss or professor sends you out to do man-on-the-street interviews for a story, think about the topic and develop a list of about ten general questions relating to it.
ex.t: 当你的老板或教授派你出去为一篇报道做街头采访时，先想想主题，并就此列出大约十个相关问题。

ex.s: The term “budget line” has several related meanings, including a couple that are self- evident and a third that is not.
ex.t: “预算线”一词有几种相关含义，包括几个不言自明的，以及一个不不言自明的。

ex.s: One of the interesting ways the study of economics relates to human behavior generally is that a lot of economic theory is the formalization of the kind of simple concept outlined above — a consumer's informal understanding of the amount she has to spend and what that amount will buy.
ex.t: 经济学研究与一般人类行为相关的一个有趣之处是，许多经济理论是对上述简单概念——消费者对可花费金额及该金额能买到什么的非正式理解——的形式化。

defs.def: to be able to understand and have sympathy with sb/sth 能够理解并同情；了解；体恤

ex.s: It aims to deepen people's understanding of issues that are related to families.
ex.t: 它旨在加深人们对与家庭有关的问题的理解。

ex.s: First, researchers need to identify all the players in that system; second, they must work out how they relate to each other; and third, they need to understand and quantify the impact of those relationships on each other and on those outside the system.
ex.t: 首先，研究人员需要识别该系统中的所有参与者；其次，他们必须弄清楚彼此之间的关系；第三，他们需要理解和量化这些关系对彼此以及对系统外各方的影响。

ex.s: These scenes may have been painted hundreds of years ago, but they record moments we can all relate to.
ex.t: 这些场景也许是数百年前画下的，但它们记录了我们每个人都能感同身受的时刻。

ex.s: Transitions can help readers understand how paragraphs work together, how they relate to one another, and how they build to a larger point.
ex.t: 过渡可以帮助读者理解段落是如何合作的，它们是如何相互关联的，如何构建到一个更大的点。
